recent.text: Ignited by Grayson Allen’s 27 PTS, Naz Reid’s big double-double and Ryan Kalkbrenner’s career-high 15 REB, the Hornets canned a season-high 23 3-pointers to beat the Cleveland Cavaliers, 124-112, on Monday night at Spectrum Center. https://t.co/yXNSkpmr9s

recent.text: Cavs 112-124 Hornets 6 game losing streak snapped, a flawless performance for the first three quarters. Happy the home crowd got to see that, much needed positive vibes Top Performers Naz⭐️⭐️ Allen⭐️⭐️ Kalkbrenner⭐️⭐️ Salaun⭐️ Bonus for that 2Q and career high https://t.co/rWcRzCT3Zp
